text: {"headline":"VP+ at Series A companies with 20-50 staff replied at 3.6x baseline (n=39)","positives":["20-50 headcount × VP+ × Series A: 41.0% reply rate (16 replies, n=39), 3.6x lift vs the 11.3% baseline.","20-50 headcount × Series A: 27.0% reply rate (17 replies, n=63), 2.4x lift.","20-50 headcount × VP+: 23.5% reply rate (19 replies, n=81), 2.1x lift."],"negatives":["51-200 headcount × Director: 2.3% reply rate (1 reply, n=44), 0.2x lift.","Directors overall: 2.7% reply rate (2 replies, n=74), 0.2x lift."],"narrative":"Focus the next campaign on VP+ contacts at Series A companies with 20-50 staff, which replied at 3.6x baseline (n=39); the broader 20-50 × Series A (n=63) and 20-50 × VP+ (n=81) segments also beat the 11.3% baseline.
